trajectory.thought: The leader is a seeded baseline (dba) and the verdict is 'indistinguishable' — the runner-up is not statistically better. With unstable ranking (Kendall tau ≈ 0), high error correlation (0.753), and only 3 validation windows making any fitted weighting high-variance, there's no principled reason to expect a different combination to beat the robust DTW barycenter. Accepting is the right call.

action_args.justification: The series is trend-dominated (strength 0.96) with weak seasonality (0.28) and non-stationary. Model ranking is unstable across the 3 validation windows (Kendall tau -0.014) and error correlation is high (mean 0.753, only 4 independent groups), so no subset or fitted weighting can reliably exploit differences. The dba (DTW barycenter) naturally respects the trend shape and provides a robust aggregation over the full pool. The leader's margin over the runner-up is indistinguishable, confirming no strategy is statistically superior.
